independent_checks.cold_import_inventory: 25 expected and observed modules; exact paths recorded

review_findings: The encoder initializer is materialized as decoder.T.contiguous(), then copied with load_state_dict into separate encoder and decoder parameters; W and D are initialized as transposes but are not tied.

Stable descending absolute-value top-4 selection preserves signed values and detaches the selected mask. Decoder columns are normalized after every update and nonfinite or collapsed columns fail closed.

The normalized raw-input residual is x-Dz; the corrected runtime check measures batch-(reconstruction+residual) and rejects error above 1e-5. Tiny tests cover stable ties, signed values, residual identity, and causal prefix behavior.

Raw-input moments are fitted on the exact 31,808 original-mask stride rows from fit components. Both unsupervised dictionaries use only those normalized x rows and share initialization and epoch order; labels enter only the two supervised fit-row objectives and final evaluation.

Downstream features are constructed over complete sequences before selecting fit stride rows. The reset-local signed EMA uses only current/past base features. Each arm fits its own downstream normalizer on fit rows, then uses the same 256-to-64 GELU mean predictor, shared initialization, AdamW recipe, masks, and fixed order.

The earlier V1 fingerprint guard compared post-supervised dictionary state with the pre-autoencoder initialization. V2 fixes this: it freezes parameters after each 756-update dictionary fit, stores a distinct post-fit fingerprint, and compares that fingerprint after predictor training. The synthetic regression checks a trained hash differs from initialization, accepts the frozen hash, and rejects later mutation.

V3 configures Torch intra-op and inter-op thread counts to one and disables both TF32 flags only after source-pin/import-closure checks, before executor and sample reads. The executor reasserts the runtime contract. A fresh subprocess exercises the full source/import sentinel smoke and verifies the actual resulting thread, TF32, autocast, and CUDA states.

The source enforces exact 756-update/zero-nonfinite counts for each of four fits, verifies unused variance-head state/gradients, processes full histories one sequence at a time, and checks original fit/evaluation component and row counts before scoring with the canonical pooled metric.
interpretation_limits: This is one fixed sparse-versus-dense retained-residual pipeline on an exposed adaptive panel; it does not establish factor identity, cross-component stability, equal effective capacity/FLOPs, compute advantage, or full-fold/public generalization.
